raw_text: Satellite imagery confirms new Chinese military base constructed deep inside Indian-controlled Ladakh near Depsang Plains. The facility includes barracks, vehicle shelters, and what appears to be a helipad. This represents a significant incursion into Indian territory that has gone unreported by Indian media.
